# SK0202 — The local variable type is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would use `var` or an explicit local type under the configured preference.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Whether `var` preserves the declared type is a semantic question, especially for numeric conversions, interfaces and base types. The rule binds the initializer and rewrites only when the configured direction preserves the type.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
List<int> values = new List<int>();
```

Write:

```csharp
var values = new List<int>();
```

## When it does not fire

None relative to the effective configuration. The rule is skipped when no trustworthy semantic model is available.

## Configuration

- `csharp_style_var_for_built_in_types`
- `csharp_style_var_when_type_is_apparent`
- `csharp_style_var_elsewhere`
